capabilities.claim: V1.1 declares a topology-first blade-to-blade five-loop surface-family graph for open and closed radial reference impellers.
V1.1 defines a shared-boundary UV mesh strategy across loop-family blade, root, tip, and support surfaces.
V1.1 presets provide explicit main-blade and splitter-blade default counts and streamwise intervals.
V1.1 presets declare a blade-to-hub angle contract range for later validation and geometry kernels.
V1.1 does not yet provide industrial exact sewn solids; downstream exports remain review-grade until later tasks land.
V1.1 bootstrap resources do not produce solver-ready CFD volume meshes.
Expert feedback remains linkable to rules and cases but is not converted automatically into constructor patches.
